title: Tau-0 VLA: Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with Test-Time Compute
summary: Shanghai Innovation Institute released tau-0-VLA on July 27, 2026 with code, paper and Hugging Face weights: a hierarchical robot foundation model whose test-time computation is guided by a world model. Rather than emitting actions in a single forward pass, the hierarchy lets the policy spend extra inference compute deliberating through world-model rollouts. The repository drew over 200 stars within days of release.
whyItMatters: It brings the language-model scaling story's second act — pay at inference, not just at training — to robot policies, with a world model as the thing being searched. Shipping open weights alongside the paper means the test-time-compute trade can be reproduced by labs that cannot afford to pretrain a VLA of their own.
